missing_intervals.reason: timestamp gap or undecodable packets between decoded audio frames

notes: timeline end = max(video duration, audio end); decoded with ffmpeg -af ashowinfo,aresample=async=1000:min_hard_comp=0.01:first_pts=0 (zero-fill of gaps so the wav axis equals the pts axis; filled samples are flagged valid=0 in audio_env.csv); timeline origin t=0 = stream pts 0; resampler swresample

loudness.detail: measured on the original stream; gaps are not zero-filled there

spectral.detail: envelope rows inside missing intervals carry valid=0
